# LoopTroop v0.4.1 is Live! 🚀

Here are the key highlights for this release:

## 🎨 Visual Prompts Editor

**Full Prompt Customization:** Take complete control over every workflow prompt and general rule block with user-editable YAML templates.

**Side-by-Side Diff & Preview:** Real-time diff against built-in defaults, live rendered previews, prompt validation, word-wrap toggle, and one-click revert/reset capabilities.

**Clean Ticket-Style Sidebar:** Nested workflow prompts under their respective statuses for fast, intuitive navigation.

## 📱 Responsive Mobile & Tablet Overhaul

**Seamless Multi-Device Experience:** Fully overhauled responsive layouts across the AppShell, Kanban board scrolling, ticket details, dialogs, profile setups, and the landing page.

## ⚙️ Human-in-the-Loop Workspace Setup

**Drafting vs. Approval Gate:** Split setup planning into an active AI drafting status and a separate, human approval gate with restart-safe versioned regeneration.

**Resilient Execution:** Current-host aware commands with graceful handling for malformed AI drafts and non-blocking Git-hook checks.

## 📖 Human-First Lifecycle & Copy Refresh

**Clearer Ticket Statuses:** Completely rewritten status summaries and detail explanations across the full lifecycle for maximum clarity.

**Reassuring Workflow Guidance:** Clearer prompts during initial phases (e.g., clarifying how skipped interview questions are handled in PRD).

## 💅 UI Polish & Reliability Upgrades

**Priority Visuals:** Updated P1–P5 priority badges with stacked vertical indicators and a clean monochrome scale.

**Smarter Integrations:** Advisory GitHub write-permission checks on repository attachment, persistent OpenRouter routing preferences, and dark mode contrast improvements across editors and modals.

**Boot Resiliency:** Boot-enabled services now remain online during temporary npm audit transport outages.

---

For the complete detailed change list, see the [LoopTroop changelog](https://www.looptroop.ovh/docs/changelog).
